images.title: First shared day
images.purpose: Recap the listing method for two schedules: list each set of multiples and the first shared number is the LCM, shown for 6 and 9.
images.composition: Two short vertical lists side by side in the centre, the shared number in each circled and joined, with one result line below; lots of white space.
exact_structure: Left column, teal #0072B2, heading Every 6 days, with exactly 3 entries top to bottom: 6, 12, 18.
Right column, amber #E69F00, heading Every 9 days, with exactly 2 entries top to bottom: 9, 18.

The 9 sits level with the 6, the place level with the 12 is left empty in the right column, and the 18 in each column sits on the same level and is circled in reddish purple #CC79A7; the two circles are joined by one horizontal reddish purple line.
Result line centred below the columns: First shared day = LCM = 18.
rejection: any entry that is not a multiple of its column number, or an entry beyond 18
a circle on any number other than 18
any of the numbers 7, 10 or 70 appearing
images.takeaway: List both schedules and the first number in both lists is the LCM.
images.description: Two lists, 6, 12, 18 and 9, 18, with 18 circled in both and joined, and the line First shared day = LCM = 18.
images.context: Shown beside the practice on when two schedules meet.
images.teaching_notes: Read down both lists together and stop at the first number that appears in both.

image_decisions.why: A short two list recap supports the schedule practice, which has no tool.
